intro:
This morning, I decided to take a drive to Eltville am Rhein, a small town along the Rhine River. With the trip quickly approaching its final days, I wanted to spend some time exploring another part of Germany.

After arriving in Eltville, I spent some time walking along the Rhine, enjoying the river and seeing the castles in the area. It was a nice change of pace from the long days of driving that have been such a big part of this adventure.

There was something enjoyable about simply walking along the river, taking in the surroundings, and exploring without having to cover a great distance.
